tape_device.description: The SCSI tape device node to configure (e.g., /dev/nst0, /dev/sg0).

key_length.description: Key length in bits for generation (128 or 256).

key_file.description: Path to the file containing the encryption key.

key_descriptor.description: Optional human-readable description for the key (used with -kd flag).

algorithm_index.description: Algorithm index to use (e.g., '1' for HP drives). Leave empty for default.

ckod.description: If true, instructs drive to clear encryption keys on volume unmount (--ckod).

protect.description: If true, protects encrypted data from raw read (--protect). If false, uses --unprotect.
